investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Amberidian Cloud (collaboration SaaS); Platform: Microsoft Azure westeurope (zones westeurope-1/westeurope-2/westeurope-3); network range 10.7.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster amberi-prod-westeu (AKS); Edge: provider-managed load balancer (edge-lb) in front of app-frontend backends; a standby load balancer exists in a secondary region; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
